content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched a new Valet accessory, describing it as a "wireless charging station and personal belongings tray."

Now, Twelve South is further expanding the Valet lineup with a smaller new model that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, with speeds up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet unveiled earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, allowing you to place your phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and other everyday items on it. However, the new-generation Valet has been significantly shrunk to just 4.25 inches.

Below is Twelve South's description of the Valet's ultimate refined design:

Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accessory, and only secondly a precision wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more tasteful appearance, suitable for placing anywhere in the home—from the entryway console table, kitchen, to the nightstand. The soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray; meanwhile, the weighted zinc-alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet's charging capability is more than enough for your iPhone, and it also includes an additional USB-C port for charging other accessories at the same time:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catch tray
  • Four freely switchable placement orientations
  • Detachable leather frame for easy replacement
  • Weighted zinc-alloy base with built-in hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power adapter and a 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for pre-order at $129.99, offered in three color combinations. It's not cheap, but it provides a beautiful and practical spot to set down your phone for charging, while also neatly holding your glasses, wallet, or keys.
